Markets.title: El Nino could add to US inflation pressures in 2027, San Francisco Fed paper warns
Markets.summary: A San Francisco Fed study warns that the current El Niño weather pattern could increase U.S. inflation by 1 percentage point in 2027. This potential climate shock may create additional pressure for the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates.

Markets.title: US manufacturing strengthens in October, input prices stay high
Markets.summary: US manufacturing activity accelerated in October with an ISM PMI of 55.5, driven by strong consumer and AI-related spending. However, elevated factory input prices of 75.2 raised concerns that inflation may remain above the Federal Reserve's 2% target.

Markets.title: Meta eyes at least $20 billion from potential bond offerings, Bloomberg News reports
Markets.summary: Meta is reportedly planning a bond offering to raise at least $20 billion. The tech company intends to use the funds to support its growing artificial intelligence infrastructure.

Markets.title: Anthropic revenue jumps 1,100% ahead of IPO as AI spending commitments near $900 billion
Markets.summary: Ahead of its upcoming IPO, Anthropic reported an 1,100% surge in third-quarter revenue to $17 billion. However, the company also disclosed a $23.3 billion net loss and nearly $895 billion in spending commitments.

Markets.summary: Indian equities opened the week strongly due to better-than-expected Q2 earnings and positive domestic economic indicators. Analysts recommend buying five specific stocks, including Tata Steel, for potential healthy returns on Tuesday.

Markets.title: Oracle plans to raise $20 billion through bonds and stock sales
Markets.summary: Oracle plans to raise $20 billion through bond and share sales to fund corporate needs and infrastructure development. The capital will specifically support advancements in AI and cloud computing, debt repayment, acquisitions, and share buybacks.

Geo-Political.summary: Russian aerial bombs struck an aid centre in a southern Ukrainian village, killing 26 people. Local officials reported that more people remained missing following the attack.

Geo-Political.summary: Fighting has resumed in the Kherson region of Ukraine following a rare six-day ceasefire. This unprecedented truce ultimately failed to change the broader trajectory of the ongoing war.

Geo-Political.title: Dutch police offer record €2m reward in hunt for drug lord
Geo-Political.summary: Dutch police have offered a record two million euro reward for information leading to the capture of convicted drug lord Jos Leijdekkers. Leijdekkers was found guilty in absentia of cocaine smuggling and is believed to be hiding in Sierra Leone.

Data & Insights.summary: India must balance fuel affordability, interest rates for savers versus borrowers, and tax incentives for foreign capital against fiscal stability. These competing economic priorities create complex trade-offs that are difficult to manage.

Data & Insights.summary: While overall consumer demand in India remains resilient, inflation driven by the West Asia war is causing stress in specific categories. This economic pressure has led to uneven festive shopping trends and price hikes for consumers.

Data & Insights.title: Imports, low base power fastest GST growth in four years in October
Data & Insights.summary: India's gross GST collections grew 23% year-on-year in October, marking the fourth month this fiscal year exceeding ₹2 trillion. This rapid growth was driven by a surge in import-related taxes and a low statistical base from the previous year.

India.summary: Police detained two teenage boys after a Tamil Nadu teen received an Instagram message and was found dead in a sack a day later. Authorities are currently questioning the suspects to determine their involvement in the murder.

India.title: DMK Leader Called Vijay "Corpse". Court Grants Her Bail, Cites Free Speech
India.summary: An Indian court granted bail to a DMK leader who called actor-politician Vijay a "corpse." The judge ruled that public figures must endure criticism and that police cannot arrest individuals for non-violent political speech.

India.title: '12th Man' Of Meghalaya Politics Paul Lyngdoh Back In Conrad Sangma Cabinet
India.summary: Paul Lyngdoh has taken the final available ministerial berth in Meghalaya Chief Minister Conrad Sangma's Cabinet. Sangma stated that no further ministers from the BJP will be added due to the constitutional limit of 12 ministers.

India.title: Analysis: Mumbai Police Fail 1 Of 3 Key Tests In Tiger Shroff Firing Case
India.summary: Although the Mumbai Police quickly arrested the suspects in the Tiger Shroff firing case, they are being criticized for failing to prevent the incident. This failure highlights shortcomings in the department's crime prevention strategies despite their swift response.
